en.title: May 20, 2026 Accessibility Digest: Police Outreach, Apple AI Features, Global Venue Access, Student Gym Pass, AI‑Driven Training
en.summary: Today's highlights include Ahmedabad Police opening a new Zone 8 office to boost public accessibility, Apple unveiling AI‑powered accessibility features across its devices, a discussion on how overseas venue accessibility shapes artist tours, a Bangalore startup offering low‑cost daily gym passes for students, and a webinar on scaling accessibility using AI and automation.

highlights.title: Ahmedabad Police Opens Zone 8 Office to Improve Public Accessibility
Apple Intelligence Introduces New Accessibility Features
Accessibility to overseas venues influences artist tours
Daily pass model improves gym accessibility for students
Webinar on Scaling Accessibility with AI and Automation
